competitors.title: How Do AI Agents Spend Your Money? (Bai et al., arXiv:2604.22750)
key_points: First systematic study of agent token consumption in coding tasks
Agentic coding consumes 1000x more tokens than code reasoning/chat tasks
Input tokens dominate total cost even with prompt caching
Same task can vary 30x in total tokens across runs
Higher token consumption does NOT correlate with higher accuracy
Frontier LLMs systematically underestimate their own token usage (max correlation 0.39)
